shots.description: Cover: header with 4 of 55 earned and the grade tally, search, filter chips (All, Story, Missable, Collectibles, Activities, Online), spoiler setting off, export/import buttons, and the checklist with the Platinum trophy and the earned Just Like Paradise guide open.

Roadmap to the platinum: all four stage cards with earned counts and spoiler masking at work (earned story trophies revealed, the rest hidden), plus the missable callout naming Positive Mental Attitude.
Missable filter active: only Positive Mental Attitude, with its MISSABLE flag, official description and count (18), its full guide with the Chapter 1 warning, steps and three cited sources.

Story filter with the spoiler setting on: the unearned Platinum and other story trophies are masked as Hidden story trophy, while the four earned story trophies show their official names, descriptions and grades.
